caption: Ameritas Life Insurance Corp. v. Wilmington Trust, N.A.
citation_line: Ameritas Life Insurance Corp. v. Wilmington Trust, N.A., No. 2:19-cv-18713, ECF No. 210 (D.N.J. Jan. 27, 2025)
headnote_district_ruling: Granted a request for a letter of request to obtain evidence abroad under Rule 28(b)(2) and the Hague Evidence Convention, while editing the proposed request to remove contested characterizations of earlier discovery.
qualification_rationale: A concise, practical illustration of judicial assistance for foreign evidence gathering in complex insurance and trust litigation.
appellate_posture_note: Non-dispositive discovery ruling; no substantive appellate review identified.
subject_screen_exclusion_reason: Foreign-evidence request governing discovery mechanics only.
